name: Narek Ishru de Mildonia
original_name: ナレク・イシュル・ド・ミリドニア
source:
Favorite food: Meat, big meat
Disliked food: Carrots, green peppers, グニっとした肉

Mildonia's first prince who is an extreme narcissistic and not interested in anything but himself.
